mcp_tools.name: firewall_rules_audit
mcp_tools.title: Firewall rules audit
mcp_tools.description: Submit a firewall ruleset and management-posture manifest; get a deterministic SOUND / UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict, including rule-level checks (any-any allows, shadowed rules, broad port ranges, sensitive-service exposure, undocumented or expired temporary rules) that name the offending rules, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The firewall evidence manifest, including the declared rules[] list (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and rule schema).

rules.description: Declared firewall rules: {id, direction, source, destination, ports, protocol, action, owner, reason, ...}.

expect.notes: All fields present and compliant. Computed spot check: 3 rules, 1 allow rule, 0 temporary rules. CORRECTED (tester error): added explicit deny-any rules deny-all-in/deny-all-out — atom requires an explicit default-deny rule in the rules list in addition to default_policy deny (its own test test_missing_explicit_default_deny_rule_fails).

checks.evidence: skill method 1: default deny, both directions — inbound starts closed
skill method 1: default deny, both directions — outbound starts closed
explicit default-deny rule present: deny-all-in
skill method 4: platform layers consistent, no conflicting opens
no any-any allow rules
no allow rule spans 1000 or more ports
no shadowed rules
no direct exposure of databases, admin panels, or agent control planes
no port-forward without a review (port-forwards are inventory items with reviews)
skill method 3: explicit egress — outbound allowlists for the services actually called
skill method 3: alert on denies to spot misconfig and compromise
every allow entry has reason + owner + date (quality gate: every allow entry has reason + owner comment)
skill method 6: changes reviewed like code
no temporary rule without a ticket and expiry date
skill method 6: old rules retired on a schedule
skill method 8: denials logged
skill method 8: denials logged with rate-limits to avoid noise floods
quality gate: post-change test — allowed path passes, disallowed fails
skill method 7: keep a smoke matrix per service
cadence_days=30 (skill: review top denied flows monthly; rule review performed on schedule)
